formal_training_authorization.rule: Passing Step6 implementation verification does not itself authorize formal training. A separate post-implementation evidence/provenance freeze and exact scientific mechanism decision are required.

implementation_constraints: Observability must be disabled or behaviorally inert for architectures that do not expose the required M4qusli counterfactual fields.
Diagnostic serialization must not detach or alter tensors before losses/gradients needed by training are computed.
Diagnostic collection must not modify logits, losses, gates, optimizer membership, gradients, parameter updates, random-number consumption, checkpoint selection or early stopping semantics.
Sample identifiers must be stable enough to audit occurrence-level records without changing dataset ordering.
Do not use a second model forward pass merely to reconstruct missing diagnostics.
No official-test loader/path may be invoked.
implementation_objective: Close v0.34 Step3 GAP1-GAP4 and create engineering evidence for GAP5 using diagnostic-only runner changes and dedicated regressions, without changing the inherited scientific mechanism.
next_stage: v0.34 Step6 鈥?controlled observability implementation and engineering verification

recoverability: Independent verifier reads only generated engineering JSON/JSONL artifacts.
Verifier recomputes target-signal distribution statistics directly from sample records.
Verifier recomputes median selector gradient over steps with non_neutral_target_count>0.
Verifier verifies parameter movement/update evidence and runtime weights.
Verifier computes validation/activation statistics when validation engineering artifacts are present.
No training rerun, model forward pass, checkpoint reselection or source-derived reconstruction is allowed.
training_path: Controlled batch contains positive and negative delta_u and at least one abs(delta_u)>=0.01 sample.
Per-sample p_candidate_true-p_ref_true equals persisted delta_u within frozen numerical tolerance.
Persisted u_target equals the inherited v0.33 target transform output; Step6 must not redefine the transform.
A step with non_neutral_target_count>0 has finite utility_loss>0 and selector_gradient_norm>1e-8.
The same step records selector_parameter_l2_update_this_step>1e-8 and finite movement_from_initial.
Effective runtime utility loss weight equals the inherited v0.33 effective weight.
Exact inactive/default intervention identity remains unchanged.

optimization_step_jsonl.constraint: Gradient norm and non-neutral-target evidence must refer to the same optimization step. Parameter update-this-step is measured across the optimizer step.

runtime_provenance.requirement: Persist effective runtime weights from the actual training computation and assert them in the engineering regression. CLI/config presence alone is insufficient.

training_sample_jsonl.constraint: One record per observed training sample occurrence for M4qusli-compatible observability mode. Values must come from the live training forward path, not a retrospective rerun.

step6_acceptance_gates: A1 exact allowlist: only the three Step5 allowlisted files may be created/modified.
A2 protected inherited controller/model/evaluator and v0.33 tests retain exact pre-Step6 SHA256 identities.
A4 dedicated v0.34 observability training-path regression passes.
A5 dedicated recoverability regression passes using persisted artifacts only.
A6 inherited v0.33 controller/training/evaluator regressions pass.
A9 controlled engineering smoke writes all Step1-required schemas and independent recoverability verifier succeeds.
A10 model-state/mechanism parity is demonstrated: observability instrumentation does not change controlled-run model outputs/updates beyond any prospectively specified deterministic tolerance.
A11 tracked staging is restricted to the exact allowlist; unrelated pre-existing untracked workspace artifacts are tolerated.
A12 official test access remains zero.
